name: Halfling
summary: Small, lucky folk who resist fear, reroll natural 1s and slip past larger creatures.

traits.name: Brave
traits.summary: Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Frightened condition.
traits.text: You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Frightened condition.

traits.name: Halfling Nimbleness
traits.summary: Move through the space of any creature a size larger than you, but you can't stop in that space.
traits.text: You can move through the space of any creature that is a size larger than you, but you can't end your move in the same space.

traits.name: Luck
traits.summary: When you roll a 1 on the d20 of a D20 Test, reroll it and use the new roll.
traits.text: When you roll a 1 on the d20 for a D20 Test, you can reroll the die, and you must use the new roll.

traits.name: Naturally Stealthy
traits.summary: You can take the Hide action while obscured only by a creature at least one size larger than you.
traits.text: You can take the Hide action even when the only thing obscuring you is a creature that is at least one size larger than you.
